description: Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Councils & Local Government - Maha Perahera Festival of Sri Pushparama  Viharasthanaya
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Pilgrimages Ordinance, establishing legal frameworks and regulatory requirements for processions and pilgrim activities during a specific festival. It outlines compliance requirements, enforcement powers, and penalties, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
